real_use_case: Assemble the minimum E1A canonical genomic model from exact artifact/QC/reference/normalization/canonical-variant attestations before EvidenceSnapshot construction.
upstream_status: Project-owned composition layer over already promoted E1A contracts; no new external scientific executor or mutable upstream dataset is introduced.
license: Independent project-owned implementation; no third-party implementation or data bytes are copied into the repository.
supported_profile: One valid single-sample germline VCF in the pinned GRCh38.p14 primary-autosome SNV/small-indel profile with passed artifact, QC, normalization, and canonical-variant identity contracts.
resource_budget: O(n) parse and output memory over the normalized callset; no network, subprocess, external database, or new dependency.
output_contract: CanonicalGenomicModelResult containing exact sample/reference/source bindings and ordered canonical variant observations with available technical and provenance fields.
known_issues: Gene mapping, transcript/consequence selection, nomenclature projection, evidence federation, and interpretation are not performed by this capability; unavailable fields are not inferred.
security: Recomputes source artifact and QC attestations from exact input bytes, revalidates canonical variant identity from normalization plus reference identity, enforces sample/count/order/provenance bindings, and performs no network, subprocess, or dynamic execution.
disable_path: This capability is not wired to a default pipeline; refuse construction unless every upstream attestation and cross-binding re-verifies against the exact bytes.
